cards.card_text: There He surrounded him, instructed him and guarded him as the apple of His eye.
cards.verse_text: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye. As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
